sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII, Section 1201 — Ceiling Heights
sources.description: Specifies minimum ceiling heights by occupancy type: 2.70m for residential, 2.40m for mezzanines, 3.00m+ for commercial/institutional.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule VIII — Stairways, Railings, and Guards
sources.description: Specifies minimum headroom clearance for stairs (2.00m), stair riser/tread dimensions, and guardrail height requirements.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule VII — Light and Ventilation Requirements
sources.description: Specifies minimum floor area, window area, and ventilation requirements that relate to room height and deck-to-deck dimensions.

sources.label: BP 344 — Accessibility and Minimum Clearances
sources.description: Provides minimum clearances for accessible routes, door widths, turning spaces, and reach ranges that affect deck and ceiling height decisions.
